You exhale corrosive gas, and acidic secretions coat your skin as you transform into a being of living acid. You gain [acid](/Traits.aspx?ID=3) immunity. Any creature that touches you or damages you with an unarmed melee attack or non-reach melee weapon takes 3d6 acid damage, and your [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=199) attacks deal 1d4 additional acid damage. The first time each round that you deal acid damage to a creature in this way, you gain 3d6 temporary HP as your body digests the eroded material and transforms it into a protective acid. When the spell ends, any remaining temporary HP expires as well. Your acid spells deal one additional die of acid damage (of the same damage die the spell uses). You can cast [_acid splash_](/Spells.aspx?ID=3) as an innate spell; the splash damage affects all creatures within 15 feet instead of the normal 5 feet.

---
**Heightened (9th)** Creatures touching you take 4d6 acid damage instead of 3d6, your unarmed attacks deal 2d4 additional acid damage, and you gain 5d6 temporary HP.

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 129 **Traditions** [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4) **Duration** 1 minute --- You recreate your form entirely out of cosmic energy, transforming into a Large battle form. You must have enough space to expand into, or the spell is lost. When you Cast this Spell, choose to take on the powers of the moon or the sun. You have hands in this battle form and can use [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645) actions. You can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) the spell. You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of the form that you choose:
  • AC = 21 + your level. Ignore your armor check's penalty and Speed reduction.
  • 20 [temporary Hit Points](/Rules.aspx?ID=2321).
  • [Darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=451).
  • One or more attacks specific to the battle form you use, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +25, and your damage bonus is +10. The melee attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example), and the ranged attacks are Dexterity based. If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.
  • [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) modifier of +25, unless your own is higher.
You also gain specific abilities based on the stellar body: - **Moon** Speed 30 feet, [fly](/Rules.aspx?ID=2350) 50 feet; **Melee** fist ([agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684), [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719)), **Damage** 2d4 bludgeoning plus 1d6 fire; **Ranged** moonbeam ([range 90 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 2d4 fire; this form’s fire damage is silver for resistances, weaknesses, and the like; on a critical hit with either Strike, the target is [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) 2 for 1 round. - **Sun** Speed 30 feet, [fly](/Rules.aspx?ID=2350) 50 feet; **Melee** fist ([agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684), [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719)), **Damage** 2d6 fire plus 1d6 [persistent fire](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86); **Ranged** sunbeam (range 90 feet), **Damage** 1d6 fire plus 1d6 persistent fire; on a critical hit with either Strike, the target is [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=65) for 1 round.

<title level="1" right="Spell 3" pfs="Standard">
[Cozy Cabin](/Spells.aspx?ID=1474)
<actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 321

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

**Deities**
[Aminara](/Deities.aspx?ID=664), [Elion](/Deities.aspx?ID=405), [Emmeton Galardaria](/Deities.aspx?ID=341), [Good Neighbors](/Deities.aspx?ID=368), [Immonhiel](/Deities.aspx?ID=626), [Malthus](/Deities.aspx?ID=528), [The Offering Plate](/Deities.aspx?ID=254), [The Spirit Wall](/Deities.aspx?ID=363), [Uskyeria](/Deities.aspx?ID=485), [Yelayne](/Deities.aspx?ID=630)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** 1 minute

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 12 hours
</row>

</column>

---

You shape a cabin 20 feet on each side and 10 feet high. This cabin has the [structure](/Traits.aspx?ID=153) trait and the same restrictions as magic items that create structures. The walls of the hut are simple and wooden, with small, square glass windows, and it has one wooden door. It doesn't include its own lock, but it has a fastener to which a lock can be applied.

 The interior contains three cots, one chamber pot, and a small fireplace holding a magical fire. The interior is lit with a small magical light that you can light or extinguish at will using a Sustain action. The climate inside the hut is comfortable and allows creatures inside it to withstand most hostile weather conditions, but incredible heat or cold, powerful storms, and winds of hurricane force or greater destroy the hut. Other creatures can freely enter and exit the hut without damaging it, but if you exit the hut, the spell ends. You can Dismiss the spell.

<title level="1" right="Spell 1" pfs="Standard">
[Cradle Aloft](/Spells.aspx?ID=2663)
<actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=645" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 130

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** touch

**Target** 1 held object of 2 Bulk or less
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You temporarily release gravity's hold on an object, allowing you to let go of it without dropping it to the floor. The object floats next to you in your space, following you if you move. You can Interact to retrieve the object on your turn as a free action. If you're within reach of another creature, that creature can spend a single action with the attack trait to attempt an [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) check against your spell DC, retrieving the object out of the air on a success. The creature must have a free hand to attempt this check. The spell ends if a creature successfully retrieves the object. If the object is floating when the spell ends, it falls.

<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Cantrip" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=550" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Earth" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=585" />

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 10 minutes
</row>

</column>

---

You hold a clump of soil, and it morphs into a small figurine in your hand. The soil transforms and hardens into a simple form of your choosing. While it does hold its shape if undisturbed, the figurine is brittle and will crumble under pressure or turn back to mush at the end of the spell's duration.

[Create Food](/Spells.aspx?ID=1475)
<actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 321

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** 1 hour

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

You create enough food to feed six Medium creatures for a day. This food is bland and unappealing, but it is nourishing. After 1 day, if no one has eaten the food, it decays and becomes inedible. Most Small creatures eat one-quarter as much as a Medium creature (one-sixteenth as much for most Tiny creatures), and most Large creatures eat 10 times as much (100 times as much for Huge creatures and so on).

---
**Heightened (4th)** You can feed 12 Medium creatures.

**Heightened (6th)** You can feed 50 Medium creatures.

**Heightened (8th)** You can feed 200 Medium creatures.

You conjure a temporary object from magical energy. It must consist of earthen or plant-derived matter (such as wood, paper, brick, or stone) and be 5 cubic feet or smaller. It can't rely on intricate artistry or complex moving parts, never fulfills a cost or the like, and can't be made of [precious](/Traits.aspx?ID=131) materials or materials with a rarity of [uncommon](/Traits.aspx?ID=159) or higher. It is obviously temporarily conjured, and thus can't be sold or passed off as a genuine item. The spell gains the appropriate trait for the item created, typically [earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=55), [plant](/Traits.aspx?ID=125), or [wood](/Traits.aspx?ID=508).

---
**Heightened (5th)** The item is metal and can include common minerals, like feldspar or quartz. The spell gains the [metal](/Traits.aspx?ID=505) trait if used to create a metal object.

The effects for each creature are determined by its Will save. Critical Success The creature is unaffected. Success For 1 round, the creature can't use reactions and must attempt another save at the start of its turn; on a failure, it is slowed 1 for that turn as it sobs uncontrollably. Failure As success, but the duration is 1 minute. Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is automatically slowed 1 for 1 minute. Heightened (7th) The area increases to a 60-foot cone.

<title level="1" right="Spell 6" pfs="Standard">

<actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Cold" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=555" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 130

**Traditions**
[Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 60 feet

**Target** 1 dying creature
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** up to 1 hour
</row>

</column>

---

You encase a [dying](/Conditions.aspx?ID=69) creature in a protective layer of enchanted ice, halting their descent toward death. The target is completely frozen in ice and remains [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=95) but stable. For the duration of the spell, they don't attempt recovery checks or take [persistent damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29). The creature can't act, speak, or perceive anything while in this state and doesn't need to breathe, eat food, or drink water to remain alive. You can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) the spell to shatter the ice and release the target.

 The ice block has AC 10, Hardness 10, and 60 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. While the ice remains unbroken, the encased creature can't take damage or be the target of spells. If the ice is destroyed, the spell ends immediately, though the creature is stabilized.

---
**Heightened (8th)** The duration becomes unlimited, and the ice block’s Hit Points increase by 20.

fields.markdown:
**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 243 **Traditions** [Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4) **Deities** [Otilaz](/Deities.aspx?ID=718), [Shawnari](/Deities.aspx?ID=600) **Range** touch **Target** 1 Large or smaller object, construct, or living creature **Defense** Fortitude **Duration** varies --- You curse the target with rapid aging or erosion. The effect depends on whether the target is an object, a [construct](/Traits.aspx?ID=563), or a living creature. [Artifact](/Traits.aspx?ID=537), along with objects and constructs made of precious materials (as determined by the GM), are immune. - **Object** If the object is attended, its bearer can attempt a Fortitude save. If the bearer fails or the object is unattended, the object immediately takes 4d6 damage (applying Hardness normally), and the item is cursed with an unlimited duration. Until the curse ends, the item becomes [shoddy](/Rules.aspx?ID=197) and can't be [Repaired](/Actions.aspx?ID=2384), and the curse attempts to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) any spell that would restore the object's Hit Points. [_Cleanse affliction_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1467) can target an item affected by this spell. - **Construct** The construct takes 4d6 damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save). On a failure, for 1 hour, the construct is [clumsy 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61), is [enfeebled 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71), and can't be Repaired, and the curse attempts to counteract any spell that would restore the construct's Hit Points. On a critical failure, these effects have an unlimited duration. - **Living Creature** The living creature must attempt a Fortitude save. Ageless creatures are immune. **Critical Success** The living creature is unaffected.
**Success** The living creature briefly ages, becoming [clumsy 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) and [enfeebled 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71) for 1 round.
**Failure** As success, with a duration of 1 hour.
**Critical Failure** As success, with an unlimited duration. --- **Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d6.

**Failure** The target transforms for 1 minute but keeps its mind. If it spends all its actions on its turn concentrating on its original form, it can attempt a Will save to end the effect immediately.
**Critical Failure** The target is transformed into the chosen harmless animal, body and mind, for an unlimited duration.

fields.markdown:
**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 130 **Traditions** [Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2) **Duration** 1 minute --- You infuse yourself with the corrupting death and pure malevolence of [Abaddon](/Planes.aspx?ID=37), transforming into a Large daemon battle form. You must have enough space to expand into, or the spell is lost. When you Cast this Spell, you choose lacridaemon, leukodaemon, meladaemon, or venedaemon. The battle form is Medium if you choose lacridaemon or venedaemon. While in this form, you gain the [daemon](/Traits.aspx?ID=568), [fiend](/Traits.aspx?ID=600), and [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521) traits. You have hands in this battle form and can use manipulate actions. You can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) the spell. You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of the form that you choose:
  • AC = 21 + your level. Ignore your armor check's penalty and Speed reduction.
  • 20 [temporary Hit Points](/Rules.aspx?ID=2321) and [weakness](/Rules.aspx?ID=2317) 5 to [holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517).
  • A +2 status bonus to all saving throws against [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=571) effects.
  • Resistance 10 to [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669).
  • [Darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=415).
  • One or more attacks specific to the battle form you use, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +21, and your damage bonus is +12. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71) condition, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.
  • [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) modifier of +23, unless your own modifier is higher.
You also gain specific abilities based on the type of Daemon you choose: - **[Lacridaemon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=4304)** Speed 25 feet, [fly](/Rules.aspx?ID=2350) 40 feet; resistance 10 to cold; **Melee** jaws ([magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 1d8 piercing plus 1d6 cold and 1d4 poison; **Melee** claw ([agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526), [magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 1d6 slashing plus 1d6 cold. - **[Leukodaemon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2893)** Speed 25 feet, [fly](/Rules.aspx?ID=2350) 40 feet; +2 status bonus to saves against diseases; **Melee** jaws ([magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d10 piercing; **Melee** claw ([agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526), [magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d6 slashing; **Ranged** composite longbow ([deadly d10](/Traits.aspx?ID=570), [magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [range increment 100 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521), [volley](/Traits.aspx?ID=730)), **Damage** 2d8 piercing. - **[Meladaemon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=4305)** Speed 25 feet, [fly](/Rules.aspx?ID=2350) 40 feet; **Melee** jaws ([magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d10 piercing; **Melee** claw ([agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526), [magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521), [void](/Traits.aspx?ID=510)), **Damage** 1d6 slashing plus 1d6 void, and after a successful Strike, you can spend an action to attempt to [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45) the target. - **[Venedaemon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2892)** Speed 25 feet; sense magical items and active spells within 60 feet as an [imprecise sense](/Rules.aspx?ID=2405); **Melee** tentacle ([agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526), [magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d6 bludgeoning.

You have hands in this battle form and can use [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104) actions. You can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) the spell. You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of the form that you choose:
  • AC = 21 + your level. Ignore your armor check's penalty and Speed reduction.
  • 15 [temporary Hit Points](/Rules.aspx?ID=2321) and [weakness](/Rules.aspx?ID=2317) 5 to [holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517).
  • A +2 status bonus to all saving throws against [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=40) effects.
  • [Resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) 10 to [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126).
  • [Darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=415).

These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13) condition, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.
  • [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) modifier of +23, unless your own modifier is higher.

**Melee** claw ([agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526), [magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 1d6+12 slashing plus 1d6 cold. - **[Leukodaemon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2893)** Speed 25 feet, fly 40 feet; +2 status bonus to saves against [diseases](/Traits.aspx?ID=578); **Melee** jaws ([magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d10+12 piercing; **Melee** claw ([agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526), [magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d6+12 slashing; **Ranged** composite longbow ([deadly 1d10](/Traits.aspx?ID=570), [magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [propulsive](/Traits.aspx?ID=677), [range increment 100 feet](/Rules.aspx?ID=2195), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521), [volley](/Traits.aspx?ID=730)), **Damage** 2d8+12 piercing. - **[Meladaemon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=593)** Speed 25 feet, fly 40 feet; **Melee** jaws ([magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d10+12 piercing; **Melee** claw ([agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526), [magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521), [void](/Traits.aspx?ID=510)), **Damage** 1d6+12 slashing plus 1d6 void, and you can spend an action after a hit to attempt to [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45) the target. - **[Venedaemon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2892)** Speed 25 feet; sense [magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644) items and active spells within 60 feet as an [imprecise sense](/Rules.aspx?ID=2407); **Melee** tentacle ([agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526), [magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d6+12 bludgeoning.

**Source** [Dark Archive](/Sources.aspx?ID=129) pg. 17 **Cast** [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284) **Range** 30 feet **Target** 1 creature **Duration** sustained up to 1 minute --- You telekinetically animate a weapon that's unattended or on your person. It brandishes itself at a foe of your choice as if wielded by an invisible duelist. When you first Cast the Spell, the weapon automatically flies to the target and Strikes. It moves along with its target, always remaining within reach. Each time you Sustain the Spell, the weapon either Changes Partners or Strikes. The weapon's attacks use and contribute to your multiple attack penalty.
  • **Change Partners** Change the weapon's target to a different creature within 30 feet. The weapon flies to its new target.
  • **Strike** ([attack](/Traits.aspx?ID=15)) The weapon attacks its target using your spell attack roll. On a hit, the weapon deals 3d6 damage, of a type determined by the weapon (if the weapon has the [versatile](/Traits.aspx?ID=200) trait or can otherwise deal multiple types of damage, you choose each time you attack).
--- **Heightened (+2)** The damage increases by 1d6. --- **Amp** The weapon's attacks increase in strength, and your control is fine enough for advanced technique. The damage dice for the weapon's Strike change from d6s to d10s. When you Cast or Sustain the spell, you can choose from the following options in addition to the standard ones.
  • **Guard** Rather than attacking, the weapon grants a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against melee attacks to the creature it's following. The bonus lasts until the start of your next turn or until the weapon Changes Partners, whichever comes first.
  • **Push** ([attack](/Traits.aspx?ID=15)) The weapon attempts to Push its target, using your spell attack roll instead of an [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) check to determine the results of the Push.

<title level="1" right="Spell 7" pfs="Standard">
[Dancing Fountain](/Spells.aspx?ID=1385)
<actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Water" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=165" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 172

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Area** 30-foot burst centered on you

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** sustained up to 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

Tapping the ground, you create a shallow pool of water that spreads over the affected area, and majestic sprays, jets, and mists of water erupt forth in a dazzling water show. When you Cast the Spell, and the first time each round you Sustain the spell, you can command the fountain to use one of the following displays, which is accompanied by a loud burst of music. The _dancing fountain_ is somewhat fickle in its desire for novelty, meaning it can't be commanded to use the same display on two consecutive turns.

- **Chasing Jets** A series of vertical jets shoot up in a chase sequence, forcing one creature within the fountain to [move](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 15 feet in a direction of your choice unless it succeeds at a Reflex save against your spell DC. The fountain can't make a creature move outside its area.
- **Flashing Spray** Diffuse fog fills the area of the emanation. All creatures within the fountain become [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4), and all creatures outside the fountain become concealed to creatures within it. The spray persists until the beginning of your next turn.
- **Power Rings** The fountain blasts a series of rings of water into the air that land with a crash in a 10-foot burst centered on a location of your choice within the fountain. The falling torrent deals 10d6 bludgeoning damage to all creatures within the burst ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex).

<traits>

<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Knights of Lastwall](/Sources.aspx?ID=123) pg. 92

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284)

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 60 feet

**Target** 1 touched shield and 1 willing creature
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** sustained up to 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You levitate the touched shield and orbit it around a nearby ally. When you Cast the Spell and Sustain the Spell, the shield uses the [Raise a Shield](/Actions.aspx?ID=98) action to protect the target creature.

---
**Heightened (4th)**  If you have the Shield Block reaction, you can use your reaction to have the target shield use Shield Block when the target creature would take damage from a physical attack, in addition to the usual trigger. In this case, Shield Block protects the target creature, rather than you. Since the shield is using Shield Block and not you, additional effects or abilities that normally apply when you Shield Block don't apply.

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Secrets of Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=96) pg. 227

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** [material](/Rules.aspx?ID=282), [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284)

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 120 feet

**Area** 20-foot burst

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

Shadows pour forth from your eyes, creating a field of [darkness](/Rules.aspx?ID=409) that prevents light from emanating within the area. Light doesn't enter the area; any non-magical light sources, such as a [torches](/Equipment.aspx?ID=60) or [lanterns](/Equipment.aspx?ID=29), don't emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. The spell similarly suppresses magical [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=100) of the spell's level or lower.

 Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. Even creatures with [darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=415) (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness; any creatures seen through the darkness are [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4) to them. Creatures with greater darkvision can see through the darkness normally.

 Creatures who move into the field or start their turn within the field have some of the life and light sucked out of them, taking 2d6 bludgeoning damage and 2d6 negative damage, with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save. 

When you cast this spell, choose up to four allies in the area to spare from _darklight's_ effects. Until the spell ends, they're immune to damage from _darklight_ spells and can see through _darklight_ (but not other darkness) as though they had greater darkvision.

---
**Heightened (10th)** The bludgeoning and negative damage both increase to 3d6.

<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Kingmaker</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Good" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=83" />
<trait label="Light" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=100" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Kingmaker Companion Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=151) pg. 71

**Traditions**
[Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284), [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283)

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** touch

**Target** 1 unattended, non-magical object of 1 Bulk or less
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** sustained up to 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

The object glows with soft golden light that lays bare the truth, reveals hidden objects, and shines supernatural light on false orders. The object casts [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407) in a 60-foot radius (and [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408) for the next 60 feet). Within the area of bright light, Perception checks to locate hidden objects (including secret doors but not traps), Will saves to resist [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163) illusions, and Will saves to resist effects placed by evil creatures that inflict the [controlled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=6) condition all gain a +2 status bonus. This light suppresses magical [darkness](/Traits.aspx?ID=39) of your _Dawnflower's light_ spell's level or lower.

 Finally, the supernatural light created by this spell is similar to sunlight, and while it can't damage creatures normally harmed by sunlight, it does make them uncomfortable so that they suffer a –2 status penalty to saves versus [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=68) effects while in the area of bright light.

---
**Heightened (7th)** The status bonus increases to +3.

**Heightened (9th)** The status bonus increases to +4.

You take an incredibly deep breath and can hold it for the spell's duration. You don't lose breath when hit, but you do lose all the air you inhaled if you speak (including to Cast a Spell). This spell doesn't create air; if you don't have air to breathe when you cast it, you get no benefit.

---
**Heightened (2nd)** The duration increases to 1 hour, and you lose only 10 minutes of breath if you speak.

**Heightened (4th)** The duration increases to 8 hours, and you lose only 10 minutes of breath if you speak.

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 118 **Traditions** [Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4) **Range** 30 feet **Area** 5-foot burst **Defense** Fortitude (see text) **Duration** 1 minute --- You stir the inner fire of all things within the area, driving out moisture. All creatures in the area take 1d6 [persistent fire damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) with a basic Fortitude save; creatures with the [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=165) or [plant](/Traits.aspx?ID=125) traits get a result one degree of success worse than they rolled. The spell ends for a creature when its persistent damage ends. A creature affected by _dehydrate_ attempts an additional Fortitude save at the end of each of its turns, before rolling to recover from the persistent damage. It can forgo this additional save if it consumed water or a similar hydrating liquid within the last round (drinking typically requires a single action). **Success** The creature takes no additional effect.
**Failure** The creature is [enfeebled 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13) until the end of its next turn.
**Critical Failure** The creature is enfeebled 2 until the end of its next turn. --- **Heightened (+2)** The range increases by 10 feet, the burst increases by 5 feet, and the persistent fire damage increases by 3d6.

fields.text: Spell 1 Dehydrate Two Actions Concentrate Fire Manipulate Source Rage of Elements pg. 118 Traditions Arcane, Primal Range 30 feet Area 5-foot burst Defense Fortitude (see text) Duration 1 minute You stir the inner fire of all things within the area, driving out moisture. All creatures in the area take 1d6 persistent fire damage with a basic Fortitude save; creatures with the water or plant traits get a result one degree of success worse than they rolled. The spell ends for a creature when its persistent damage ends. A creature affected by dehydrate attempts an additional Fortitude save at the end of each of its turns, before rolling to recover from the persistent damage. It can forgo this additional save if it consumed water or a similar hydrating liquid within the last round (drinking typically requires a single action). Success The creature takes no additional effect. Failure The creature is enfeebled 1 until the end of its next turn. Critical Failure The creature is enfeebled 2 until the end of its next turn. Heightened (+2) The range increases by 10 feet, the burst increases by 5 feet, and the persistent fire damage increases by 3d6.

---

A manifested version of your deity's favored weapon made of pure magical might appears in the air above the target. This weapon attacks using your spell attack modifier. On a hit, the weapon deals 7d12 force damage, or double damage on a critical hit. 

After the attack, whether it succeeds or fails, divine energy bursts from the weapon in a shock wave. It emits in a 10-foot-wide, 30-foot-long [line](/Rules.aspx?ID=2388) starting from the target and continuing in a direction you choose. Your target and any other creatures within the area of the spell take 5d6 spirit damage, with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save.

---
**Heightened (9th)** The force damage increases by 1d12, and the spirit damage increases by 1d6.

**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 261

**Mystery**
[Life](/Mysteries.aspx?ID=17)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Target** 1 creature
</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

With a surge of healing energy, you push back against an affliction threatening the target and grant a small amount of healing. The target recovers 3d8 Hit Points. You attempt to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) any one affliction you are aware the target has, suspending its effects for 1 hour on a success rather than removing it. The target is then temporarily immune to _delay affliction_ for 1 day. You don't need to have identified the name of the specific affliction, but you do need to be aware of it; for instance, you couldn't delay an [ingested](/Traits.aspx?ID=633) [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669) during its onset period unless you were aware of the poison.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The target recovers an additional 1d8 Hit Points, and you can attempt to suspend an additional affliction.

You transpose the moment that the target would be injured to a point later in its timestream. Roll damage normally, but do not reduce Hit Points or apply any other effects of the attack until the spell’s duration has elapsed. When the spell ends, the target is immediately affected by the attack, taking damage and being affected by any additional effects. You can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) this spell.

---

You unleash a catastrophic downpour in the area that vanishes an instant later. All flying creatures in the area descend 50 feet or until blocked by the ground or firm surface. Each creature whose descent was blocked by the ground or firm surface takes bludgeoning damage equal to the number of feet it fell (the creature does not also take falling damage) and is knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31). Creatures on the ground, including flying creatures forced to the ground by the spell, must succeed at a Reflex save or be pushed 50 feet away from the center of the area.

 Flimsy structures in the area collapse. The GM can determine other large-scale effects that result from the deluge.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The area increases by 10 feet, and flying creatures fall an additional 10 feet.

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 373 **Domain** [Confidence](/Domains.aspx?ID=67) **Range** 30 feet **Target** 1 creature **Defense** Will **Duration** varies --- You make the target overconfident, leading it to ascribe failure to external factors. The target attempts a Will save to determine the spell's duration and is temporarily immune for 24 hours regardless of the save's result. **Critical Success** The target is unaffected.
**Success** The duration is 1 round. If the target fails at an attack roll or skill check, it takes a –1 status penalty to attack rolls and skill checks until the end of its turn (or the end of its next turn, if it attempted the roll outside its turn). If the creature fails a second time while taking this penalty, the penalty increases to –2.
**Failure** As success, but the duration is 10 minutes.
**Critical Failure** As success, but the duration is 24 hours.

When you Cast this Spell, choose abrikandilu, brimorak, kithangian, or vloriak. If you choose kithangian, the battle form is Large, and you must have enough space to expand into, or the spell is lost. While in this form, you gain the [demon](/Traits.aspx?ID=573), [fiend](/Traits.aspx?ID=600), and [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521) traits. You have hands in this battle form and can use [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645) actions. You can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) the spell. You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of the form that you choose:
  • AC = 20 + your level. Ignore your armor check's penalty and Speed reduction.
  • 30 [temporary Hit Points](/Rules.aspx?ID=2321), [weakness](/Rules.aspx?ID=2317) 5 to [cold iron](/Equipment.aspx?ID=375), and weakness 5 to [holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517).
  • [Darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=415).
  • One or more attacks specific to the battle form you use, which are the only attacks you can [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +22, and your damage bonus is +12. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example). If your attack modifier is higher for the given unarmed attack or weapon, you can use it instead.
  • [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) modifier of +23, unless your own modifier is higher.
You also gain specific abilities based on the type of demon you choose: - **[Abrikandilu](/Monsters.aspx?ID=4318)** Speed 25 feet; **Melee** jaws ([magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d6 piercing, and [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) 1 for 1 minute on a critical hit; **Melee** claw ([agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526), [magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d6 slashing; **Ranged** hurled debris ([range increment 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d6 bludgeoning. - **[Brimorak](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2896)** Speed 30 feet; **Melee** flaming sword ([magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d8 slashing plus 1d6 fire; **Melee** hoof ([agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526), [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d4 bludgeoning plus 1d6 fire. - **[Kithangian](/Monsters.aspx?ID=4320)** Speed 30 feet; **Melee** pincer ([magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684), [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 1d12 slashing, and after a successful Strike you can spend an action to attempt to [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45) the target; **Melee** stinger ([agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526), [magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684), [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 1d8 piercing; all melee Strikes deal an additional 2d6 precision damage to [animals](/Traits.aspx?ID=531). - **[Vloriak](/Monsters.aspx?ID=4319)** Speed 25 feet; [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) 10 to acid; **Melee** claw ([unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d6 piercing plus 1d6 spirit; **Melee** tongue ([agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684), [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 1d6 acid plus 1d6 spirit.

You pull the moisture from the targets' bodies, dealing 10d10 void damage. Creatures made of water (such as [water elementals](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=45)) and [plant](/Traits.aspx?ID=125) creatures use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of their saving throw. Creatures whose bodies contain no significant moisture (such as [earth elementals](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=42)) are immune to _desiccate_.

You hold a shield together with the power of your magic, forcing wood and steel to fuse back together. The shield remains at 1 Hit Point and isn't destroyed. Its construction is weakened until someone takes the time to repair it, preventing _desperate repair_ or a similar ability from saving the same shield until your next daily preparations.

<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Knights of Lastwall](/Sources.aspx?ID=123) pg. 93

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** 10 minutes ([material](/Rules.aspx?ID=282), [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284))

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 1 mile

**Target** 1 destroyed undead
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** sustained
</row>

</column>

---

You examine the remains or spiritual residue of a destroyed undead creature to locate that undead's creator, perhaps a necromancer or vampire. If the creator is within range, you can sense the direction to them. If the creator is within 100 feet, you sense their presence within 100 feet, and the spell ends; you can't further home in on their location. If there's lead or running water between you and the undead's creator, this spell can't locate them. This spell fails automatically if the undead doesn't have a specific creator or the specific creator isn't on the same plane.

**Traditions**

**Bloodline**

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Area** 30-foot emanation

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

 You detect [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=92) magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your _detect magic_ spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an [_invisibility potion_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=187)) typically are detected normally.

---
**Heightened (3rd)** You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

**Heightened (4th)** As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an [imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412) sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>

<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />

<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Metal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=505" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 142

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Area** 30-foot emanation

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

You attune yourself to magnetic fields, becoming aware of the presence or absence of metallic objects, veins, and deposits within the area. You can choose to ignore metal you're fully aware of, such as the gear you and your allies wear and carry.

 You _detect metal_ hidden by [illusions](/Traits.aspx?ID=92) (such as [_invisibility_](/Spells.aspx?ID=164)) only if the illusion has a lower rank than your _detect metal_ spell. Against deceptive illusions, _detect metal_ always notices an absence of metal when a non-metallic object is disguised as metallic. However, if the deception involves disguising one metallic object as another, such as pretending a copper coin is made of gold, _detect metal_ registers only the presence of metal, not its type, even if the rank of your _detect metal_ spell exceeds that of the illusion effect.

---
**Heightened (3rd)** You can discern all types of metal you detected. Your spell can overcome deceptive illusory spells hiding one metal as another if the magic effect's rank is lower than that of your _detect metal_ spell.

You cause the magic within the target to dissipate in a destructive explosion. You attempt to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) the target. If the attempt succeeds, an explosion of magical force deals 8d6 force damage with a basic Reflex save. If you successfully counteract the magic of an item, it's deactivated for 1 week (or destroyed on a critical success) and the explosion is a 5-foot emanation from the item. If you successfully counteract a spell, the effect ends and the explosion affects either all creatures in the spells' area or the target of the spell and all creatures in a 5-foot emanation around it.

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 132 **Traditions** [Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2) **Duration** 1 minute --- You bind yourself to the power of [Hell](/Planes.aspx?ID=42), transforming into a Medium devil battle form. When you Cast this Spell, choose coarti, levaloch, sarglagon, or vordine. If you choose levaloch or sarglagon, the battle form is Large, and you must have enough space to expand into, or the spell is lost. While in this form, you gain the [devil](/Traits.aspx?ID=575), [fiend](/Traits.aspx?ID=600), and [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521) traits. You have hands in this battle form and can use [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645) actions. You can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) the spell. You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of the form that you choose:
  • AC = 22 + your level. Ignore your armor check's penalty and Speed reduction.
  • 5 [temporary Hit Points](/Rules.aspx?ID=2321), [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) 5 to physical damage (except [silver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=379)), and [weakness](/Rules.aspx?ID=2317) 5 to [holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517).
  • Resistance 10 to [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604).
  • [Darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=415).
  • One or more attacks specific to the battle form you use, which are the only attacks you can [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +20, and your damage bonus is +12. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71) condition, for example). If your attack modifier is higher for the given unarmed attack or weapon, you can use it instead.
  • [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) modifier of +23, unless your own modifier is higher.
You also gain specific abilities based on the type of devil you choose: - **[Coarti](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2907)** Speed 25 feet, [fly](/Rules.aspx?ID=2350) 40 feet; **Melee** morningstar ([magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521), [versatile P](/Traits.aspx?ID=724)), **Damage** 2d6 bludgeoning plus 1d6 spirit; **Melee** wing ([agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526), [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521), [versatile P](/Traits.aspx?ID=724)), **Damage** 1d6 bludgeoning plus 1d6 fire. - **[Levaloch](/Monsters.aspx?ID=4327)** Speed 30 feet, [climb](/Rules.aspx?ID=2349) 30 feet; +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude DC against being [Shoved](/Actions.aspx?ID=2380) and to other saving throws to resist being moved against your will; **Melee** trident ([magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d8 piercing; **Ranged** trident ([magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [thrown 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=711), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d8 piercing; all melee Strikes deal an additional 2d6 precision damage to [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61), [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71), [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=81), or [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=90) creatures. - **[Sarglagon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2908)** Speed 25 feet, [fly](/Rules.aspx?ID=2350) 25 feet, [swim](/Rules.aspx?ID=2351) 30 feet; **Melee** fangs ([magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d10 piercing; **Melee** tentacle arm ([agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526), [magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 1d8 bludgeoning plus 1d6 poison. - **[Vordine](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2906)** Speed 25 feet; **Melee** trident ([magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d8 piercing; **Melee** hoof ([agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526), [magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 1d4 bludgeoning plus 1d6 fire; **Melee** whip ([disarm](/Traits.aspx?ID=577), [magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [nonlethal](/Traits.aspx?ID=661), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684), [trip](/Traits.aspx?ID=716), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d4 slashing; **Ranged** trident (magical, thrown 20 feet, unholy), **Damage** 2d8 piercing.

fields.summary_markdown: Turn into a devil battle form.
fields.text: Spell 6 Devil Form Two Actions Polymorph Transmutation Unholy Source Secrets of Magic pg. 99 Traditions Arcane, Divine Cast somatic, verbal Duration 1 minute You bind yourself to the power of Hell, transforming into a Medium devil battle form. When you cast this spell, choose coarti, levaloch, sarglagon, or vordine. If you choose levaloch or sarglagon, the battle form is Large and you must have enough space to expand into or the spell is lost. While in this form you gain the devil and fiend traits. You have hands in this battle form and can use manipulate actions. You can Dismiss the spell. You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of the form that you choose: AC = 22 + your level. Ignore your armor check's penalty and Speed reduction. 5 temporary Hit Points, resistance 5 to physical damage (except silver), and weakness 5 to holy. Resistance 10 to fire. Darkvision. One or more attacks specific to the battle form you use. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +20, and you use the listed damage. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example). If your attack modifier is higher for the given unarmed attack or weapon, you can use it instead. Athletics modifier of +23, unless your own modifier is higher. You also gain specific abilities based on the type of devil you choose: - Coarti Speed 25 feet, fly 40 feet; Melee Single Action morningstar (magical, unholy, versatile P), Damage 2d6+12 bludgeoning plus 1d6 spirit; Melee Single Action wing (agile, unholy, versatile P), Damage 1d6+12 bludgeoning plus 1d6 fire. - Levaloch Speed 30 feet, climb 30 feet; +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude DC against being Shoved and to other saving throws to resist being moved against your will; Melee Single Action trident (magical, unholy), Damage 2d8+10 piercing; Ranged Single Action trident (magical, thrown 20 feet, unholy), Damage 2d8+10 piercing; all melee Strikes deal 2d6 additional precision damage to clumsy, enfeebled, immobilized, or restrained creatures. - Sarglagon Speed 25 feet, fly 25 feet, swim 30 feet; Melee Single Action fangs (magical, unholy), Damage 2d12+10 piercing; Melee Single Action tentacle arm (agile, magical, unholy), Damage 1d8+10 bludgeoning plus 1d6 poison. - Vordine Speed 25 feet; Melee Single Action trident (magical, unholy), Damage 2d8+12 piercing; Melee Single Action hoof (agile, magical, unholy), Damage 1d4+12 plus 1d6 fire; Melee Single Action whip (disarm, magical, nonlethal, reach 10 feet, trip, unholy), Damage 2d4+10 slashing; Ranged Single Action trident (magical, thrown 20 feet, unholy), Damage 2d8+12 piercing.

**Target** one door or similar opening

Will

**Duration** 8 hours
</row>

</column>

---

Drawing from superstitions about scaring a devil by threatening to nail horseshoes to their hooves, you conjure a silver horseshoe over an entrance. A fiend that passes through the target takes 2d6 spirit damage and must attempt a Will save.

<column gap="tiny">

**Critical Success** The fiend is unaffected.

**Success** The fiend takes half damage, and attacks against the fiend are treated as magical silver for 1 round.

**Failure** The fiend takes full damage and is [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71) 1 and [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) 1 for 1 minute. Attacks against the fiend are treated as magical silver for 1 minute.

**Critical Failure** The fiend takes double damage and is enfeebled 2 and stupefied 2 for 1 minute. Attacks against the fiend are treated as magical silver for 10 minutes.

</column>

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6.

**Duration** sustained up to 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

Your apparition's dark power blends with your physical body, allowing you to take on terrifying characteristics of creatures that lurk in dark places. Your arms and legs transform into twisting tentacles. You gain a tentacle unarmed attack with 10-foot [reach](/Traits.aspx?ID=684) that deals 1d8 bludgeoning damage and has the [grapple](/Traits.aspx?ID=619) trait. The first time you Sustain this spell each round, you can attempt a single [Grapple](/Actions.aspx?ID=2376) check with your tentacle against a creature within its reach.

---
**Heightened (2nd)** You can choose to take on the shark battle form from [_animal form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1440) instead of gaining a tentacle unarmed attack, heightened to the same level as this vessel spell. When you do, this spell loses the morph trait and gains the [polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=670) trait. You can attempt a jaws unarmed Strike against a creature within your reach each time you Sustain this spell.

**Heightened (5th)** You can choose to take on the water elemental battle form from [_elemental form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1510) instead of gaining a tentacle unarmed attack, heightened to the same level as this vessel spell. When you do, this spell loses the morph trait and gains the polymorph trait. You can attempt an unarmed attack Strike against a creature within your reach each time you Sustain this spell.

---

You don a diadem of radiant light, which sheds [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=2402) to a range of 60 feet and [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=2403) to a further 60 feet. When you Cast the Spell and when you [Sustain](/Actions.aspx?ID=2317) it during the duration, you can draw a disc of spiraling light from the diadem and throw it at a creature within 120 feet. Make a ranged spell attack at mythic proficiency against the target's AC. This action has the [attack](/Traits.aspx?ID=540) and [spirit](/Traits.aspx?ID=737) traits. On a hit, you deal 4d8 spirit damage, 1d4 [persistent spirit damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86), and the target is [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=65) for 1 round (3 rounds on a critical hit). The persistent damage isn't doubled on a critical hit. 

If the disc passes through an area of magical [darkness](/Traits.aspx?ID=569) or targets a creature affected by magical darkness, the disc's glow attempts to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=2250) the darkness using your [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=46) or [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=44) skill modifier as the counteract check modifier and half your level as the counteract rank.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The disc’s divine damage increases by 2d8, and the persistent damage increases by 1d4.

You supercool the nearby air, forming a cloud of dancing ice crystals in an emanation around you. A creature other than you that enters the area or ends its turn within the area takes 2d6 [cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=555) damage. A creature can take this damage only once per turn. The crystals scatter and refract light; if a light effect enters diamond dust’s area, any creatures targeted by that effect gain a +2 status bonus to AC and saves against it. While the spell persists, you can activate or deactivate this aura by [Sustaining](/Actions.aspx?ID=2317) the spell. You can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) this spell.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The damage increases by 1d6.

You manipulate the boundaries between planes like a scalpel, using it to cut away portions of a creature’s essence and banishing those portions to other realities and dimensions, afflicting the target deep lacerations or even severed appendages. The creature takes 14d10 damage (no damage type) and 2d10 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86) and must attempt a Will save. If the target is not on its home plane, it takes a –4 status penalty to this save. A creature reduced to 0 HP has their entire body sectioned out and banished across multiple planes and dimensions, leaving nothing behind but their gear.

---
**Heightened (10th)** The base damage increases by 2d10, and the persistent bleed damage by 1d10.

fields.markdown:
**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 324 **Tradition** [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4) **Deities** [Balumbdar](/Deities.aspx?ID=674), [Sobek](/Deities.aspx?ID=642), [Valani](/Deities.aspx?ID=486), [Zevgavizeb](/Deities.aspx?ID=442) **Duration** 1 minute --- You channel the primal forces of nature to transform into a Large animal battle form, specifically that of a powerful and terrifying dinosaur. When you Cast this Spell, choose a listed battle form. You can decide the specific type of animal, but this has no effect on the form's Size or statistics. While in this form, you gain the [animal](/Traits.aspx?ID=9) and [dinosaur](/Traits.aspx?ID=45) traits. You can Dismiss the spell. You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form you choose:
  • AC = 18 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
  • 15 temporary Hit Points.
  • Low-light vision and imprecise scent 30 feet.
  • One or more [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=199) melee attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +16, and your damage bonus is +9. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13) condition, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.
  • [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) modifier of +18, unless your own is higher.
You also gain specific abilities based on the form you choose: - **Ankylosaurus** Speed 25 feet; **Melee** tail ([backswing](/Traits.aspx?ID=173), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 2d6 bludgeoning; **Melee** foot, **Damage** 2d6 bludgeoning. - **Brontosaurus** Speed 25 feet; **Melee** tail ([reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 2d6 bludgeoning; **Melee** foot, **Damage** 2d8 bludgeoning. - **Deinonychus** Speed 40 feet; **Melee** talon ([agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170)), **Damage** 2d4 piercing plus 1 [persistent bleed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29); **Melee** jaws, **Damage** 1d10 piercing. - **Stegosaurus** Speed 30 feet; **Melee** tail ([reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 2d8 piercing. - **Triceratops** Speed 30 feet; **Melee** horn, **Damage** 2d8 piercing, plus 1d6 [persistent bleed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) on a critical hit; **Melee** foot, **Damage** 2d6 bludgeoning. - **Tyrannosaurus** Speed 30 feet; **Melee** jaws ([deadly d12](/Traits.aspx?ID=174), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 1d12 piercing; **Melee** tail ([reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 1d10 bludgeoning. --- **Heightened (5th)** Your battle form is Huge and your attacks have 15-foot reach, or 20-foot reach if they started with 15-foot reach. You instead gain 20 temporary HP, an attack modifier of +18, a damage bonus of +6, double the damage dice, and Athletics +21. **Heightened (7th)** Your battle form is Gargantuan and your attacks have 20-foot reach, or 25-foot reach if they started with 15-foot reach. You instead gain AC = 21 + your level, 25 temporary HP, an attack modifier of +25, a damage bonus of +15, double the damage dice, and Athletics +25.

You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form you choose: AC = 18 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction. 15 temporary Hit Points. Low-light vision and imprecise scent 30 feet. One or more unarmed melee attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +16, and your damage bonus is +9. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead. Athletics modifier of +18, unless your own modifier is higher. You also gain specific abilities based on the form you choose: - Ankylosaurus Speed 25 feet; Melee Single Action tail (backswing, reach 10 feet), Damage 2d6 bludgeoning; Melee Single Action foot, Damage 2d6 bludgeoning. - Brontosaurus Speed 25 feet; Melee Single Action tail (reach 15 feet), Damage 2d6 bludgeoning; Melee Single Action foot, Damage 2d8 bludgeoning. - Deinonychus Speed 40 feet; Melee Single Action talon (agile), Damage 2d4 piercing plus 1 persistent bleed; Melee Single Action jaws, Damage 1d10 piercing. - Stegosaurus Speed 30 feet; Melee Single Action tail (reach 10 feet), Damage 2d8 piercing. - Triceratops Speed 30 feet; Melee Single Action horn, Damage 2d8 piercing, plus 1d6 persistent bleed on a critical hit; Melee Single Action foot, Damage 2d6 bludgeoning. - Tyrannosaurus Speed 30 feet; Melee Single Action jaws (deadly d12, reach 10 feet), Damage 1d12 piercing; Melee Single Action tail (reach 10 feet), Damage 1d10 bludgeoning. Heightened (5th) Your battle form is Huge and your attacks have 15-foot reach, or 20-foot reach if they started with 15-foot reach. You instead gain 20 temporary HP, an attack modifier of +18, a damage bonus of +6, double the damage dice, and Athletics +21. Heightened (7th) Your battle form is Gargantuan and your attacks have 20-foot reach, or 25-foot reach if they started with 15-foot reach. You instead gain AC = 21 + your level, 25 temporary HP, an attack modifier of +25, a damage bonus of +15, double the damage dice, and Athletics +25.

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 500 feet

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 24 hours (see text)
</row>

</column>

---

You conjure a primeval fort with walls of sharpened wood adorned with dinosaur skin and teeth, up to 300 feet on a side. Each of the four quadrants of the fort is guarded by a [tyrannosaurus](/Monsters.aspx?ID=123). While the tyrannosauruses won't cross into the others' territories, their reach allows them to simultaneously attack an intruder near the center of the fort. The tyrannosauruses leave you and anyone you introduce to them alone but treat anyone else they find in the fort as intruders and prospective snacks. When you prepare spells, you can choose not to recover the spell slot you used to cast this spell. If you do, the fort remains for another 24 hours.

 The fort must be created on a plot of land free of other structures. It adapts to the natural terrain, adopting the structural requirements for being built there. The fort adjusts around small features, such as ponds or spires of rock, but can't be created on water or other nonsolid surfaces. If created on snow, sand dunes, or other soft surfaces with a solid surface underneath, the foundation reaches solid ground. If created on a solid but unstable surface, such as a swamp or an area plagued by tremors, roll a DC 3 flat check each day the fort is present; on a failure, the fort sinks or collapses sometime during that day, and the spell ends.

 The fort doesn't harm creatures within the area when it appears, and it can't be created within a crowd or in a densely populated area. Any creature inadvertently caught inside the fort when the spell is cast ends up unharmed inside the complete fort and always has a clear path of escape.

You alter how an item's or spell's magical aura appears to effects like [_detect magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=66). You can hide the auras entirely, have an item register as a common item of lower level, or make a spell register as a common spell of the same or lower rank. You can Dismiss the spell.

 A caster using _detect magic_ or [_read aura_](/Spells.aspx?ID=246) of a higher rank than _disguise magic_ can attempt to disbelieve the illusion using the skill matching the tradition of the spell ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) for [arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) for [divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) for [occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120), or [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) for [primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=134)). Further attempts by the same caster get the same result as the initial check to disbelieve.

---
**Heightened (2nd)** You can Cast this Spell on a creature, disguising all items and spell effects on it.

---

A black tracer bolt flies toward your target, and upon making contact intensifies into a powerful destructive beam. Make a spell attack against the target. If you hit an object or force construct (such as a [_wall of force_](/Spells.aspx?ID=363)), it's destroyed with no save unless it's an [artifact](/Traits.aspx?ID=253) or similarly powerful. A single casting can destroy no more than a 10-foot cube of matter. 

If you hit a creature, it takes 12d10 damage (no damage type) with a basic Fortitude save. If you critically hit, the target gets a result one degree of success worse than the outcome of its Fortitude save. A creature reduced to 0 HP is blasted to fine powder; its gear remains.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d10.

</title>

<traits>

<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=645" />

**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 244

**Traditions**

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** touch

**Target** 1 non-magical object in your possession of 1 Bulk or less
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You touch an object, and it immediately disassembles itself into its component pieces. The spell fails if the target lacks component pieces (such as a statue carved from one block of stone), and using it on a dangerous object like a snare or trap typically triggers it. The object gains the [broken](/Conditions.aspx?ID=60) condition, and the component pieces become small enough to be hidden under normal clothing and armor. You can Dismiss the spell. When the spell ends, the object reassembles itself into its original form, appearing in your hand or hands if you have them free, or on the ground in front of you otherwise. Once reassembled, the object loses the broken condition, and its Hit Points return to the value the object had when you Cast the Spell.

---
**Heightened (4th)** The spell lasts for 10 minutes.

**Heightened (6th)** The spell lasts until your next daily preparations.

**Area** 10-foot burst centered on one corner of your space

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 10 minutes
</row>

</column>

---

You create an immobile globe around yourself. It attempts to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) any spell from outside the globe whose area or targets enter into it, as if the globe were a [_dispel magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=78) spell 1 rank lower than its actual spell rank. If the counteract attempt succeeds, it prevents only the portion of the spell that would have entered the globe (so if the spell also has targets outside the globe, or part of its area is beyond the globe, those targets or that area are affected normally). You must form the sphere in an unbroken open space, so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost (though creatures can enter the globe after the spell is cast).

<actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Cantrip" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=22" />

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Dark Archive](/Sources.aspx?ID=129) pg. 23

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284)

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Area** one 5-foot square

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** sustained up to 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You create a magical lens that distorts space as best suits you. You create the lens in a space in range, even suspended in midair. If your or an ally's ranged attack passes through the lens, the attack gains an additional 10 feet of range; if an enemy's ranged attack would pass through the lens, it requires an additional 10 feet of range to move through, though the enemy knows before using its ability whether the interference puts the target out of range. An ally whose space overlaps the lens can increase the range of its ranged attacks, but an enemy whose space overlaps the lens doesn't reduce the range of its ranged attacks.

 The first time each round you Sustain the Spell, you can choose to relocate it to another square within range. The lens disappears if you cast _distortion lens_ again.

---
**Heightened (+3)** The lens increases or decreases the range of abilities by an additional 5 feet.

---

<column gap="tiny">
**Amp** The lens can interfere with creatures as well as attacks. Once during a Medium or smaller ally's move action, the ally can move into and out of the lens's square without that square counting against the total distance moved. Conversely, the lens is difficult terrain for your enemies.

</column>

Each splash deals 3d10 bludgeoning damage to all creatures in a 5-foot emanation; creatures in multiple splash zones take damage only once. Heightened (+1) The damage dealt by each splash increases by 1d10.

fields.markdown:
<title level="1" right="Spell 3" pfs="Standard">
[Dividing Trench](/Spells.aspx?ID=1114)
<actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Earth" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=55" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Knights of Lastwall](/Sources.aspx?ID=123) pg. 93

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** [material](/Rules.aspx?ID=282), [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284)

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 120 feet

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You dig an earthen trench across the surrounding terrain, which must be soil, clay, sand, or other soft earth, but not flooring or stone. The trench is 5 feet wide, 5 feet deep, and up to 15 feet long. You can shape the trench's path, but it must be one continuous line. You must conjure the trench in an open space so it doesn't pass through any creatures or objects. Creatures inside the trench have [cover](/Rules.aspx?ID=459) from creatures outside the trench, and creatures outside the trench have cover from creatures inside the trench. Particularly small creatures in the trench might have more cover against other creatures who aren't close to the trench's edge, and in turn, those creatures might have more cover against small creatures in the trench; the GM determines the amount of additional cover, if any. Entering or leaving the trench requires an additional 5 feet of movement but doesn't require any kind of check and isn't considered difficult terrain. At the end of the spell's duration, the trench disappears and all creatures in the trench remain in their spaces on solid ground.

---
**Heightened (+2)**  The trench's maximum length increases by 15 feet.
